requirements.label: credits
requirements.title: Minimum credits and upper-division credits

rule.text: Completion of the Black Heritage Studies Minor requires a minimum of 18 credits, with at least 9 upper division credits.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit total and upper-division credit minimum cannot be expressed with the available rule types.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the Black Heritage Studies Minor requires a minimum of 18 credits, with at least 9 upper division credits.

policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the minor, except those graded S/U must be passed with a letter grade C or higher.

notes.text: Courses graded S/U are excepted from the letter grade C or higher requirement.
The Black Heritage Studies minor combines history, anthropology, and archeology, the study of an African language, and studies abroad.
SOC 365 - Global Africa appears twice in the elective list; it is modeled once, grouped with AFS 365.
